notes.title: SHRIME: THE GENESIS OF BUTT-EYE
notes.content:
Let's jump back into Japanese folklore with SHIRIME: BUTT-EYE.

A very special Japanese monster with an EYE placed in a very unusual spot.

Help SHARON save her sister!
